checks.name: hard_source_preservation
checks.rule: All unique THUMB/INDEX sources retain their fixed labels before/after closure; conflict or mutation FAIL_CLOSED.

checks.name: graph_connectivity_and_reachability
checks.rule: Exact candidate IDs/hashes; one component, complete hard sets, no unreachable mm source fields.

checks.name: label_components_and_islands
checks.rule: Compute induced same-label components on final graph. After closure every component must contain own-digit authority source; enumerate all unsupported islands, no second-largest identity heuristic.

checks.name: sheet_split
checks.rule: Derive fresh unlike-label cut-edge set, remove those edges from full frozen face dual adjacency; enumerate components by stable face IDs. Identify sheets by independent marker/nail/cap overlap. If marker identities collide or nail/cap references cannot consistently identify counterparts, fail revalidation; do not guess by size.

checks.name: ambiguous_band
checks.rule: abs(dT_mm-dI_mm)<TAU_mm on finite fresh fields; explicitly report FIRST_WEB21 and conservative band intersections; no hard pin from ambiguity. Re-evaluate after closure, without historical targets.

checks.name: CLASS_A_six_edge_geometry
checks.rule: Keep the six frozen edge IDs/endpoints and original polygons/coordinates. No topology edit or erroneous-edge reclassification; fresh labels are evaluated/reported, no requirement to reproduce historical THUMB labels.

checks.name: INDEX_sheet_identity
checks.rule: Independent native INDEX tip v233 plus approved INDEX nail faces/vertices must consistently identify the INDEX counterpart; never second-largest component.

checks.name: THUMB_sheet_identity
checks.rule: Independent native THUMB tip v284 plus cap37 and approved thumb nail identify the THUMB counterpart.

checks.name: wrappers_and_deformation_followup
checks.rule: Separate cap/nail buckets, frozen FIRST_WEB context and CMC geometry remain unchanged. Future skin weights, targeted deformation and full Stage6 needed after successful fresh R3; not executed or approved by this input candidate.

checks.name: deterministic_reproducibility
checks.rule: Same frozen candidate and metric yields identical fields/cut/closure under sorted IDs and declared tie rules; historical diff not a success metric.
